quote: Domeyko project will demand a total capex of USD 247 million, which will be financed through a project finance term-loan of USD 176 million provided by a consortium of leading international banks – SMBC, Société Générale, and Scotiabank –, and together with a USD 12 million in VAT debt financing provided by Scotiabank. Equity will be provided as part of Verano’s partnership with Lumina Capital Management… Located in northern Chile near Vallenar in the Atacama Region… Construction is underway, with commercial operations expected by the end of 2026.
note: Opened Verano Energy company press page 2026-10-02.
